Overview

Semey is a city in Abai with a population of 350,000. A historic city on the Irtysh River in eastern Kazakhstan, a major cultural center and former nuclear test site region. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
